core_obligations: Show dim(W_kappa) <= r and sp_{X/R}([W_K]_r) = [W_kappa]_r for W closed flat over the DVR with dim(W_K) <= r (proof lines 469-473). Taking F = O_W, the closed subscheme cycle [W] is the module construction: by chow-lemma-cycle-closed-coherent (tag 02QY) the cycle associated to the closed subscheme W is the cycle associated to O_W pushed forward to X, and the specialization statement for the module construction is lemma-specialization-module (tag 0H4I), which gives exactly the claimed dimension bound and specialization identity (proof lines 470-472).
proof_roadmap: Identify [W] with the module construction via F = O_W using the Chow Homology closed-coherent lemma (proof lines 470-472).
Read off the dimension bound and the specialization identity from the module lemma (proof lines 470-472).
